name: Daily Broker Crawler

on:
  schedule:
    # 設定為每天台灣時間下午 4:30 執行 (UTC 時間早上 8:30)
    - cron: '30 8 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch: # 🌟 加入這個設定，讓你可以隨時在網頁上手動點擊執行按鈕

jobs:
  crawl:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write # 允許機器人把抓好的資料寫回(Push)你的 Repo

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v5
      with:
        python-version: '3.11' 

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        # 直接安裝我們需要的套件，免去 requirements.txt
        pip install pandas playwright
        # 安裝 Playwright 瀏覽器核心與系統依賴
        playwright install --with-deps chromium

    - name: Run crawler
      run: |
        # 執行指揮官程式 (預設會抓你設定在 HOT_STOCKS 裡面的股票)
        python update_broker.py

    - name: Commit and Push changes
      run: |
        # 讓機器人具備推播權限
        git config --local user.name "github-actions[bot]"
        git config --local user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
        
        # 將 data 與 docs 資料夾的新資料加入追蹤
        git add data/ docs/
        
        # 存檔並推播 (如果沒有新資料則略過避免報錯)
        git commit -m "🤖 自動更新券商分點資料 [skip ci]" || echo "No changes to commit"
        git push
